name: Jared Carthalion
description: A wayfarer, aged sixteen by the end, who learns magic from Kristina, destroys the Golgothian Sylex and triggers his planeswalker spark.

description_citations.text: "Wayfarer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liana gives the Moxen to Kristina and Jared during her duel with Ravidel so he will not take them.
timeline.quote: Liana gave them to Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion during her duel with Ravidel at Minorad so that he would not take them.

citation.text: "Mox", section "Moxen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, Ravidel uses Mox Jet, Mox Ruby and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon against Jared and his allies.
timeline.quote: Ravidel used the Mox Jet , Mox Ruby , and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon

citation.text: "Mox", section "Moxen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel lures six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forces them to battle in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Ravidel used an artifact known as the Mox Beacon to lure other planeswalkers to Corondor.

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around the New Phyrexian Invasion Corondor falls under Geyadrone Dihada's control again.
timeline.quote: the island fell back under the control of Geyadrone Dihada

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adam sacrifices his wife to Ravidel, refuses to sacrifice Jared and battles Ravidel; Jared is hit by a syphon soul and changed.

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared grows up a beggar in Arathoxia raised by Ezer.

timeline.summary: Ravidel conquers Arathoxia; Jared steals the Lotus, leads refugees against Ravidel at Castle Melmereth and summons a Shivan Dragon.
timeline.quote: Ravidel tracked Jared down and conquered Arathoxia

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina takes Jared in, teaches him all mana, and they fall in love.
timeline.quote: They eventually fell in love

timeline.summary: Adam Carthalion is defeated by Ravidel at Ephren, entrusts his spelltrove and infant Jared to Ezer, and obliterates Ravidel's barge and himself with Inferno.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A treefolk defends the sleeping infant Jared from wolves in the forest of Krisylthas.
timeline.quote: the tree they are resting against is a treefolk

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 2: Desolate Angel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Castle Melmereth Ravidel reveals Adam was a liar and killer who murdered Gwendolyn for power and planned to sacrifice Jared before changing his mind.

timeline.summary: The Elder Druid of Corondor finds Jared with Yorgo's help and warns of the coming war while Jared tends to Kristina as she gives birth to Justina.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
